system.description:
Required Weapon: Broadsword & Panzerhand Eisenfaust uses an iron gauntlet to deflect or trap attacks, setting up brutal counters. A patient and punishing Eisen style, practiced by many veterans of the War of the Cross.

  • Iron Retort. After successfully avoiding damage from an attack, you can mark a Stress to make an attack that deals 2d4 extra damage.
  • Panzershield. Whenever you take damage, you may mark a Stress to reduce the damage by 2d4.
  • Dangerous Counters. You gain a bonus to your damage rolls equal to twice your number of marked Hit Points.
